name: Cnú Deiréil

attributes.attribute: harpist in the company of Fionn Mac Cumhaill
great hero whom Cnú served as harpist
a dwarf harper with golden hair about 4 feet high
claimed as a son of Lugh

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cnú Deiréil is the dwarf fairy harper of the Fenian Cycle. Irish storytellers call him the little nut of melody. He plays the harp for Fionn Mac Cumhaill and fills the hall with delight and play. The same tiny musician brings on sweet slumber with his songs. He stands perhaps 4 feet high, and golden hair crowns him. He claims Lugh of the long hand as his father. The encyclopedia sends the reader to the account under the Dwarves for more detail on him.

okr.objective: Cnú Deiréil is a hero who served Fionn as his harpist.
